message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Code check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: ["*"]
  push:
    branches: ["main"]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

env:
  FORCE_COLOR: 3

jobs:
  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Format
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - name: Check formatting
        run: pnpm format:check

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Lint
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm check:bases

  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Typecheck
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - run: pnpm typecheck

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Test
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - run: pnpm test

  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: E2E
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17.4
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: tablecn
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: securepassword
          POSTGRES_DB: tablecn
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U tablecn -d tablecn"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://tablecn:securepassword@localhost:5432/tablecn
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/setup

      - name: Enable extensions
        run: pnpm exec tsx src/db/extensions.ts

      - name: Create the database
        run: pnpm exec drizzle-kit push --force

      - name: Seed
        run: pnpm exec tsx src/db/seed.ts

      - name: Install Playwright
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm exec next build

      - name: Test
        run: pnpm test:e2e",
  "rationale": "The workflow already bounds the e2e job with timeout-minutes: 20 and cancels superseded runs via concurrency cancel-in-progress, but the format, lint, typecheck, and test jobs have no explicit timeout, so a hung job can consume the default runner budget. This matches pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout), which is supported by measured CI workflow evidence: experiment batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 (26.82% elapsed savings) and experiment batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8 (9.79% elapsed savings) both added timeout-minutes to jobs while keeping all steps and checks passing. I add timeout-minutes: 20 to the four unbound jobs, reusing the same bound already present for e2e rather than inventing a new value. No steps, permissions, secrets, network access, or deployment operations are changed, so build/test coverage is preserved and no new privileged actions are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}
